case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You told us your CNC machines are ready to start on the HX pump shaft. We want to keep that capacity busy, but the award will go to the best overall package, and we cannot promise it in advance.

Option A is the package we can approve. It sets a price level that fits the claims below and gives your shop a clear order with a defined lead time.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On competing offers:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material costs:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We would like to place this work with a family company we know, but your offer has to stand next to the others. Option A is the clearest route to that.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A is built for that: it gives you the planning security of the longest payment term we offer, with a clear delivery lead time attached.

Option A is the package we can approve. On quality and on the alloy surcharge, our reasons are these:

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Several bidders are competing for this pump shaft, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance, but Option A is the one we can take forward.

For your management, in plain words: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec a place as supplier for the new HX series, a settled payment term and a delivery lead time that both sides can plan around. Please take Option A to your decision-maker as it stands.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

You wrote that you would clarify anything unclear, so let me be direct: your price for the HX pump shaft is not yet where we can place the order, but we would like to find the solution that keeps your shop busy with our work.

On the competing offers:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).
Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On your side:
Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).

The award goes to the best overall package, and we promise it to no one in advance. Option A is the package we can approve, because it sets a unit price that stands clearly against the other offers while giving you a clear payment term and a fixed lead time for a long-running series part.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option B is a genuine alternative if a longer payment term suits you better. Both are serious proposals from one family company to another, and we would be glad to build on the years of cooperation.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, I looked at your numbers on the material and the other quote, and you're right, things have moved. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. The 14 days payment is good for us, so I'm dropping the price to €30.00 with the 35 days lead time you asked for. 

Our Angebot is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Let's agree on this so we can get the machines running.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Best regards
Purchasing
